text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I came to the shrine with Hokko Tarumae,
who hasn't been in top form lately.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... the banners caught my eye, and I just couldn't help it.
It reminded me of how the local shrine back home looked during festivals.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
They hold various events throughout the year, like seasonal
festivals and Hatsumode!
I even had my Shichi-Go-San celebration at that shrine—

text_block_list.name: Locals
text_block_list.text:
—Oh, Tarumae-chan, is it your Shichi-Go-San visit?
—My, look how big you've grown.
—We'll have to bring by a gift later.

text_block_list.name: Local Lady
text_block_list.text:
So well-mannered. At this rate,
she might become Tomakomai's number-one star in the future.

text_block_list.name: Young Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
A staaar...! If I become one,
can I make Tomakomai
super famous?

text_block_list.name: Locals
text_block_list.text:
—Oh my, how dependable!
—I'm sure you can do it, Tarumae-chan.
—We're all cheering for you.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"...I... grew up surrounded and watched over
by such warm, wonderful people."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: —Alright! I'm gonna work even, even harder to promote Tomakomai!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Hokko Tarumae embraced a positive mindset, and afterwards, got back into peak condition!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...That's right... I'm supposed to perform well here...
and get everyone even more excited, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The gap between reality and the ideal she had envisioned left Hokko Tarumae feeling thoroughly dejected...
